title: A Safari With Friends: How to Plan for a Group
excerpt: A safari with friends is great fun. How to plan for a group: vehicles, accommodation and shared costs.
body:
## Group size

A safari vehicle seats six to seven. For larger groups, plan two vehicles.

## Accommodation

Some camps can be booked exclusively for groups.

## Decisions

Agree beforehand on budget, pace and priorities.

## Shared costs

Private vehicles are cheaper per person in a group.

## Activities

Balloon flights, walking safaris, Kilimanjaro or diving together.

## Organisation

One contact person makes communication easier.

See [private or group safari](/blog/private-vs-group-safari/) or [plan your group trip](/travel-proposal/).
